callees.name: list_staged_domain_knowledge_relpaths
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a string path to an existing work directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a sorted list of relative path strings, each pointing to a staged domain knowledge file under the work directory's domain_context/user_knowledge/ subdirectory, prefixed with the given prefix and work_dir. Returns an empty list if no staged files exist.
